ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate macro-level ratio of 75% low-intensity (black) pixels to 25% high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white mottling on the lateral margins of both lobes, transitioning to dominant low-intensity black in the central and peduncle regions; the left lobe shows a larger, more concentrated white patch compared to the more diffuse spotting on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary; notable deep pixel-amplitude indentations are present on the medial portion of the left lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex trajectory toward the distal lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel groupings at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible across the right lobe and central-right surface, cutting through the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustations on the distal tips and numerous intersecting linear white scars (rake marks) across the fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, deep secondary jagged notch located on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe.
